summary.en: Israel continues air and drone strikes in southern Lebanon, killing a Hezbollah operative and wounding another, and setting homes ablaze, while Hezbollah fires artillery at Israeli positions. Lebanon reports a civilian killed and another wounded by an Israeli strike on a motorcycle, and another strike wounded one person. Hezbollah has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel fortsetter luft- og droneangrep i sørlige Libanon, der en Hezbollah-operativ ble drept og en annen såret, og hvor boliger ble satt i brann, mens Hezbollah skyter artilleri mot israelske posisjoner. Libanon melder om en sivil som ble drept og en annen såret av et israelsk angrep på en motorsykkel, og et annet angrep såret én person. Hezbollah har begynt å distribuere sine første kontantutbetalinger til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
